**Shop URL**

**Request**

- [ ] Please add this shop
- [ ] I represent this shop and would like it removed
- [ ] I represent this shop and can provide a product feed

**If you can provide a feed:** a Google Merchant / Facebook catalogue XML URL is ideal — it is
more accurate than crawling and lets us update stock more often.

**Anything else we should know** (crawl restrictions, contact address, preferred update times)
